_comment: Rules table for scripts/modelsrc.py (model source tree in sdk/modelsrc/).
Everything the pipeline does that is not a plain decompile is driven from here or
derived from the shipped MDL itself, so that no source file is edited by hand.
Keys of 'models' are paths under gamedir/syndicate/models without the .mdl extension.
_comment_layout: Folder layout. v_/w_/p_ models go to weapons/<weapon>/<prefix>/ and player/<x>/<x>.mdl to
players/<x>/ automatically. Everything else needs an entry in 'folders'.
_comment_textures: Texture names. Every name is lower-cased and accents are removed (cote, poignee).
'generic_texture_names' are placeholder names that different models use for different
images; they become <model>-<name> (precedent: chainsawsword-null.bmp in the
rotating-weapons sources). 'texture_renames' is for one-off cases: {model: {old: new}},
old name as stored in the MDL.
_comment_install: scripts/modelsrc.py install. 'install_skip': models that are never put into gamedir/
(model -> reason); models with stand-in textures are skipped as well. 'install_delete':
files under models_dir that no model uses and that go when the models are installed
(only deleted if no remaining model header names them). 'install_stand_ins': the only
models with stand-in textures that install may put into gamedir/ (model -> note; every
other check still applies to them). 'install_keep': model files in the folder that are
not built from sources (model -> why); package refuses any other unbuilt model.

install_keep.p_wong: intentionally empty model (bare hands) that the game code precaches; shipped as is
install_keep.gmmode: new model (Game Master mode display), not a decompile: compile sdk/modelsrc/misc/gmmode/gmmode.qc by hand (cd there; studiomdlplusplus gmmode.qc -o <dir>) and copy gmmode.mdl here

_comment_models: what          one-line description for the inventory
note          free text copied to the inventory 'unusual' column
skip          reason: the model gets no source folder (cannot be decompiled)
keepallbones  true: write $keepallbones (for a model whose rebuilt bone table would
otherwise differ; none needs it so far)
placeholder_textures  true: the model has no textures inside and its texture file does
not ship; the sources get generated stand-in textures (dev_placeholder.bmp)
add_idle_sequence  true: give a model that ships without any sequence a one-frame
'idle' in the reference pose (on for the three p_ models;
every stock p_ model has one and the renderer reads the first sequence)
The Zombie Grunt fix needs no entry: the fix is 'compile zgrunt as one file, with
no external sequence groups', which is what the pipeline does for every model.

cyberimp.what: Copy of the imp under another name

hunted.note: not the player model (that is player/hunted/hunted.mdl)

w_weaponbox.what: Weapon box (weaponbox) and satchel world model

p_wong.what: Fist of Legend player-held model: bare hands
p_wong.skip: intentionally empty (bare hands): nothing to decompile, no sources needed

w_grenade.what: Hand grenade world model (weapon_handgrenade) and thrown grenade
